description: Defines UI design tokens, custom view components, and style helpers for consistent Android-like theming in a SwiftUI-based iOS app.

classes.name: AndroidRefCard
classes.description: A styled container view that mimics a card with padding, border, and rounded corners.

classes.name: AndroidRefTextFieldStyle
classes.description: A custom TextField style providing padding, background fill, border, and corner radius.

classes.name: AndroidRefPrimaryButtonStyle
classes.description: A button style representing a filled primary (blue) button with height, corner radius, and opacity for disabled state.

classes.name: AndroidRefChipButtonStyle
classes.description: A small stylized button (chip) with background, border, and specific size.

methods.name: AndroidRefCard.init
methods.description: Initializer that accepts a ViewBuilder content closure to construct the card content.

methods.name: AndroidRefTextFieldStyle._body
methods.description: Defines the body of the TextField style with padding, background, overlay, and clip shape.

methods.name: AndroidRefPrimaryButtonStyle.makeBody
methods.description: Creates the visual representation of the primary button, handling pressed and disabled states.

methods.name: AndroidRefChipButtonStyle.makeBody
methods.description: Creates the visual appearance of the chip button, with styling for pressed state.

methods.name: View.androidRefScreenPadding
methods.description: Extends View to add consistent horizontal padding based on theme constants.
